responsibility: This implementation module is the full buffered file-runtime for GNU Modula-2. It manages dynamic file descriptors and per-file buffers through the Indexing module, wraps low-level libc open/read/write/close/lseek calls, tracks file usage and error state, provides character-, string-, and byte-oriented input/output with buffering and unread support, implements random-access repositioning and filename bookkeeping, and installs a termination hook to flush StdOut and StdErr, making it the core persistent file subsystem on which higher-level I/O modules depend.
same_name_distinction: This is the concrete buffered file runtime behind FIO.def, implementing descriptor records, per-file buffers, Indexing-backed handle management, low-level open/read/write/lseek integration, and stdout/stderr flush-on-termination behavior.
